title.en: Combustion
title.gu: Combustion

title.en: Combustion and classification of fuels
title.gu: Combustion તથા Fuels નું વર્ગીકરણ

body.en:
Definition and principle

Combustion is an exothermic oxidation process in which a fuel reacts with an oxidant. Fuels are first classified as solid(coal, coke, biomass), liquid(fuel oil, petrol, ethanol) and gaseous(natural gas, producer gas, biogas). They may also be classified as primary/natural or secondary/manufactured.

Balance method and important conditions

Complete carbon combustion gives CO2; incomplete combustion may form CO, unburnt hydrocarbons or soot. Hydrogen forms water and sulfur is commonly idealized as SO2 in elementary balances. Fuel nitrogen is often assigned to N2 in the stated simplified model; that is not a prediction of zero real NOx. Do not equate sufficient total oxygen with guaranteed complete real combustion.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Fuel તથા oxidant વચ્ચેની exothermic oxidation process Combustion છે. પ્રથમ Solid(coal, coke, biomass), Liquid(fuel oil, petrol, ethanol) અને Gaseous(natural gas, producer gas, biogas) classification કરો. Primary/natural તથા Secondary/manufactured classification પણ કરી શકાય છે.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Complete carbon combustion માં CO2 અને incomplete combustion માં CO, unburnt hydrocarbons અથવા soot મળી શકે છે. Elementary balance માં hydrogen થી water તથા sulfur થી SO2 માનવામાં આવે છે. Fuel nitrogen ને stated simple model માં N2 ગણાય છે; તે real NOx zero હોવાની આગાહી નથી. પૂરતું total oxygen હોવાથી real combustion હંમેશાં complete થાય એવું નથી.

title.en: Proximate and ultimate analysis of solid fuel
title.gu: Solid Fuel નું Proximate તથા Ultimate Analysis

h.en: Proximate and ultimate analysis of solid fuel
h.gu: Solid Fuel નું Proximate તથા Ultimate Analysis

body.en:
Definition and principle

Proximate analysis reports moisture, volatile matter, ash and fixed carbon. Fixed carbon is calculated by difference for the stated test basis; it is not identical to elemental carbon. Ultimate analysis reports elemental carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, sulfur and the separately declared moisture/ash content.

Balance method and important conditions

Typical proximate workflow determines moisture by controlled drying, volatile matter by the prescribed covered-crucible heating method, and ash by controlled oxidation; calculate fixed carbon last. Exact temperatures/times and corrections follow the adopted standard, not an invented universal SOP. As-received, dry and dry-ash-free analyses have different denominators. State whether reported H/O includes fuel moisture to avoid counting its water twice.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Proximate Analysis માં moisture, volatile matter, ash તથા fixed carbon આવે છે. Stated test basis પર fixed carbon difference થી મળે છે; તે elemental carbon જેવું નથી. Ultimate Analysis માં elemental C, H, O, N, S તથા separately declared moisture/ash આવે છે.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Typical proximate workflow માં controlled drying થી moisture, prescribed covered-crucible heating થી volatile matter અને controlled oxidation થી ash મળે છે; છેલ્લે fixed carbon કાઢો. Exact temperature/time તથા corrections adopted standard મુજબ છે, invented universal SOP મુજબ નહીં. As-received, Dry તથા Dry-ash-free bases ના denominators જુદા છે. Reported H/O માં moisture સામેલ છે કે નહીં તે લખો, નહીં તો water double count થશે.

title.en: Gross/net calorific values and Dulong estimate
title.gu: Gross/Net Calorific Values તથા Dulong Estimate

h.en: Gross/net calorific values and Dulong estimate
h.gu: Gross/Net Calorific Values તથા Dulong Estimate

body.en:
Definition and principle

Calorific value is the heat released by complete combustion of a unit amount of fuel under specified reference conditions. Gross/higher calorific value includes condensation of product water to liquid; net/lower calorific value leaves that water as vapour at the declared reference condition.

Balance method and important conditions

State kJ/kg, kJ/kmol or kJ per specified standard volume; gas volume values require a temperature/pressure definition. The correction from gross to net includes combustion water from hydrogen and fuel moisture, when applicable. Dulong is an empirical estimate for suitable solid/liquid fuels, not an exact law; use the stated coefficient set, units and elemental-analysis basis. Bomb-calorimeter measurements are constant-volume energy data and can require correction to an enthalpy-based value.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Specified reference conditions પર unit amount fuel ના complete combustion થી મળતી heat Calorific Value છે. Gross/Higher value માં product water ને liquid સુધી condense કરવાનું heat સામેલ છે; Net/Lower value માં તે water stated reference condition પર vapour રહે છે.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

kJ/kg, kJ/kmol અથવા specified standard-volume basis લખો. Gas volume value માટે temperature/pressure જોઈએ. Gross થી net correction માં hydrogen થી બનેલું water તથા applicable fuel moisture ગણો. Dulong suitable solid/liquid fuels માટે empirical estimate છે, exact law નહીં; આપેલો coefficient set, units તથા elemental-analysis basis લો. Bomb-calorimeter data constant-volume energy છે; enthalpy value માટે correction જરૂરી હોઈ શકે છે.

title.en: Theoretical oxygen/air,excess air and flue-gas basis
title.gu: Theoretical Oxygen/Air,Excess Air તથા Flue-gas Basis

h.en: Theoretical oxygen/air,excess air and flue-gas basis
h.gu: Theoretical Oxygen/Air,Excess Air તથા Flue-gas Basis

body.en:
Definition and principle

Theoretical oxygen is the stoichiometric oxygen required for the specified complete combustion model. Theoretical air supplies that oxygen. Excess air is air supplied above theoretical air, expressed as a fraction or percentage of theoretical air. Dry flue gas excludes water vapour; wet flue gas includes it.

Balance method and important conditions

For elementary molar calculations assume dry air 21 mol%O2/79 mol%N2 only when stated. Use79/21 for the nitrogen-to-oxygen molar ratio. Do not use21 mass%O2; the matching mass fraction with MW O2=32,N2=28 is about0.233. For ultimate-analysis balances subtract oxygen already in the fuel. Include excess O2, inert N2, fuel nitrogen,SO2, moisture and any CO specified. Do not divide dry-gas amounts by the wet total. A measured dry O2 percentage is not itself the excess-air percentage.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Specified complete-combustion model માટેની stoichiometric oxygen demand Theoretical Oxygen છે. તે oxygen પૂરો પાડતી air Theoretical Air છે. Theoretical air કરતાં વધારાની supplied air ને તેના fraction/percentage તરીકે Excess Air કહીએ. Dry flue gas માં water vapour કાઢી નાખો; Wet માં સામેલ કરો.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Elementary molar calculation માં stated dry air 21 mol%O2/79 mol%N2 લો.N2/O2 molar ratio 79/21 છે.21 mass%O2 ન લો; MW O2=32,N2=28 માટે matching mass fraction આશરે 0.233 છે. Ultimate analysis માં fuel માં પહેલેથી રહેલો oxygen subtract કરો. Excess O2, inert N2, fuel nitrogen,SO2, moisture તથા specified CO ગણો. Dry-gas amounts ને wet total થી ન ભાગો. Measured dry O2 percentage પોતે excess-air percentage નથી.

title.en: Fuel/air/flue-gas calculation checklist
title.gu: Fuel/Air/Flue-gas Calculation Checklist

body.en:
Calculation workflow

Declare as-received/dry/dry-ash-free fuel basis and whether H/O excludes moisture. State air molar composition. Do not equate21 mol% with21 mass%.Subtract fuel oxygen from theoretical O2. Include excess O2, air/fuel N2,SO2, CO if specified, and water from both H and moisture. Calculate wet and dry totals separately. Check C, H, O, N, S and total mass including ash.

How to practise honestly

Rework the solved cases without seeing the answer, then compare equations, units and closure. Change one input at a time and recheck feasibility. These are study exercises, not laboratory readings.
body.gu:
Calculation Workflow

Fuel ની as-received/dry/dry-ash-free basis અને H/O માં moisture સામેલ છે કે નહીં તે લખો. Air ની molar composition લખો.21 mol%ને 21 mass%ન માનો. Fuel oxygen ને theoretical O2માંથી subtract કરો. Excess O2, air/fuel N2,SO2, specified CO તથા H/moisture નું water ગણો. Wet તથા dry totals અલગ લો. C, H, O, N, S તથા ash સહિત total mass check કરો.

પ્રમાણિક Practice કેવી રીતે કરવી

પ્રથમ answer જોયા વગર solved cases ફરી કરો. પછી equations, units તથા closure સરખાવો. એક સમયે એક input બદલીને feasibility ફરી check કરો. આ study exercises છે, laboratory readings નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Combustion and classification of fuels.
q.gu: Combustion તથા Fuels નું વર્ગીકરણ ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Combustion is an exothermic oxidation process in which a fuel reacts with an oxidant. Fuels are first classified as solid(coal, coke, biomass), liquid(fuel oil, petrol, ethanol) and gaseous(natural gas, producer gas, biogas). They may also be classified as primary/natural or secondary/manufactured. Complete carbon combustion gives CO2; incomplete combustion may form CO, unburnt hydrocarbons or soot. Hydrogen forms water and sulfur is commonly idealized as SO2 in elementary balances. Fuel nitrogen is often assigned to N2 in the stated simplified model; that is not a prediction of zero real NOx. Do not equate sufficient total oxygen with guaranteed complete real combustion.
a.gu: Fuel તથા oxidant વચ્ચેની exothermic oxidation process Combustion છે. પ્રથમ Solid(coal, coke, biomass), Liquid(fuel oil, petrol, ethanol) અને Gaseous(natural gas, producer gas, biogas) classification કરો. Primary/natural તથા Secondary/manufactured classification પણ કરી શકાય છે. Complete carbon combustion માં CO2 અને incomplete combustion માં CO, unburnt hydrocarbons અથવા soot મળી શકે છે. Elementary balance માં hydrogen થી water તથા sulfur થી SO2 માનવામાં આવે છે. Fuel nitrogen ને stated simple model માં N2 ગણાય છે; તે real NOx zero હોવાની આગાહી નથી. પૂરતું total oxygen હોવાથી real combustion હંમેશાં complete થાય એવું નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Proximate and ultimate analysis of solid fuel.
q.gu: Solid Fuel નું Proximate તથા Ultimate Analysis ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Proximate analysis reports moisture, volatile matter, ash and fixed carbon. Fixed carbon is calculated by difference for the stated test basis; it is not identical to elemental carbon. Ultimate analysis reports elemental carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, sulfur and the separately declared moisture/ash content. Typical proximate workflow determines moisture by controlled drying, volatile matter by the prescribed covered-crucible heating method, and ash by controlled oxidation; calculate fixed carbon last. Exact temperatures/times and corrections follow the adopted standard, not an invented universal SOP. As-received, dry and dry-ash-free analyses have different denominators. State whether reported H/O includes fuel moisture to avoid counting its water twice.
a.gu: Proximate Analysis માં moisture, volatile matter, ash તથા fixed carbon આવે છે. Stated test basis પર fixed carbon difference થી મળે છે; તે elemental carbon જેવું નથી. Ultimate Analysis માં elemental C, H, O, N, S તથા separately declared moisture/ash આવે છે. Typical proximate workflow માં controlled drying થી moisture, prescribed covered-crucible heating થી volatile matter અને controlled oxidation થી ash મળે છે; છેલ્લે fixed carbon કાઢો. Exact temperature/time તથા corrections adopted standard મુજબ છે, invented universal SOP મુજબ નહીં. As-received, Dry તથા Dry-ash-free bases ના denominators જુદા છે. Reported H/O માં moisture સામેલ છે કે નહીં તે લખો, નહીં તો water double count થશે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Gross/net calorific values and Dulong estimate.
q.gu: Gross/Net Calorific Values તથા Dulong Estimate ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Calorific value is the heat released by complete combustion of a unit amount of fuel under specified reference conditions. Gross/higher calorific value includes condensation of product water to liquid; net/lower calorific value leaves that water as vapour at the declared reference condition. State kJ/kg, kJ/kmol or kJ per specified standard volume; gas volume values require a temperature/pressure definition. The correction from gross to net includes combustion water from hydrogen and fuel moisture, when applicable. Dulong is an empirical estimate for suitable solid/liquid fuels, not an exact law; use the stated coefficient set, units and elemental-analysis basis. Bomb-calorimeter measurements are constant-volume energy data and can require correction to an enthalpy-based value.
a.gu: Specified reference conditions પર unit amount fuel ના complete combustion થી મળતી heat Calorific Value છે. Gross/Higher value માં product water ને liquid સુધી condense કરવાનું heat સામેલ છે; Net/Lower value માં તે water stated reference condition પર vapour રહે છે. kJ/kg, kJ/kmol અથવા specified standard-volume basis લખો. Gas volume value માટે temperature/pressure જોઈએ. Gross થી net correction માં hydrogen થી બનેલું water તથા applicable fuel moisture ગણો. Dulong suitable solid/liquid fuels માટે empirical estimate છે, exact law નહીં; આપેલો coefficient set, units તથા elemental-analysis basis લો. Bomb-calorimeter data constant-volume energy છે; enthalpy value માટે correction જરૂરી હોઈ શકે છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Theoretical oxygen/air,excess air and flue-gas basis.
q.gu: Theoretical Oxygen/Air,Excess Air તથા Flue-gas Basis ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Theoretical oxygen is the stoichiometric oxygen required for the specified complete combustion model. Theoretical air supplies that oxygen. Excess air is air supplied above theoretical air, expressed as a fraction or percentage of theoretical air. Dry flue gas excludes water vapour; wet flue gas includes it. For elementary molar calculations assume dry air 21 mol%O2/79 mol%N2 only when stated. Use79/21 for the nitrogen-to-oxygen molar ratio. Do not use21 mass%O2; the matching mass fraction with MW O2=32,N2=28 is about0.233. For ultimate-analysis balances subtract oxygen already in the fuel. Include excess O2, inert N2, fuel nitrogen,SO2, moisture and any CO specified. Do not divide dry-gas amounts by the wet total. A measured dry O2 percentage is not itself the excess-air percentage.
a.gu: Specified complete-combustion model માટેની stoichiometric oxygen demand Theoretical Oxygen છે. તે oxygen પૂરો પાડતી air Theoretical Air છે. Theoretical air કરતાં વધારાની supplied air ને તેના fraction/percentage તરીકે Excess Air કહીએ. Dry flue gas માં water vapour કાઢી નાખો; Wet માં સામેલ કરો. Elementary molar calculation માં stated dry air 21 mol%O2/79 mol%N2 લો.N2/O2 molar ratio 79/21 છે.21 mass%O2 ન લો; MW O2=32,N2=28 માટે matching mass fraction આશરે 0.233 છે. Ultimate analysis માં fuel માં પહેલેથી રહેલો oxygen subtract કરો. Excess O2, inert N2, fuel nitrogen,SO2, moisture તથા specified CO ગણો. Dry-gas amounts ને wet total થી ન ભાગો. Measured dry O2 percentage પોતે excess-air percentage નથી.
